task.title: Physically Securing Digital Devices
task.shortdesc: Physically securing devices to prevent cyber criminals from downloading malware onto the device, gaining unauthorized access, or stealing the device.

taskbody.context: Without physical safeguards in place to protect your device(s), you are more vulnerable to cyber intrusions that occur because of a physical security compromise. This could lead to direct installation of malware or spyware, loss or theft of devices and data, or unauthorized access of your data. Follow these steps to protect your devices:

step.cmd: Ensure there are physical security controls in the areas where you store your devices.
Keep important documents in a secure location.
Lock your device if you have to step away from the screen.
Do not leave your devices unattended.
Have a plan for data loss or theft.
Do not throw away or sell your old device.
Do not insert unknown media storage devices (e.g., thumb drives) into your computer.
Do not charge your device in a public USB port without a data blocker.
